title: Lock-out Severity Multiplier by Requested Reset — Harborline Customer Accounts
content:
**Product:** Harborline Customer Accounts — goodwill for late recovery review decisions

The lock-out severity multiplier of the late-review goodwill follows what the request asked to reset, as the requested change on the recovery request record shows: a request to remove two-factor and change the sign-in email takes 1.5, a request to change the sign-in email takes 1.25, and a request to remove two-factor only takes one. The multiplier multiplies the late-review goodwill figure.

| Requested change on the recovery request | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| remove two-factor and change the sign-in email | 1.5 |
| change the sign-in email | 1.25 |
| remove two-factor only | 1 |

*Example, hypothetical:* a figure of $8.00 for a request that changed the sign-in email becomes $10.00.
